claim: The Schrödinger equation is not Poincaré invariant.
falsifier: One can verify by direct computation whether the Schrödinger equation retains its form under Poincaré transformations; it does not.

conditions: standard formulation of quantum mechanics using the Schrödinger equation
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the formal property of the Schrödinger equation as stated; transfer to other formulations or interpretations is unestablished.

title: Quantum mechanics via–invariance of the Schrödinger theorem
